tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are a student who has been working on a research project and need to request an extension on the deadline from your professor, Dr. Jones. You have encountered some unexpected challenges that have delayed your progress.
Write an email to Dr. Jones. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Ask for an extension on the deadline.
Provide details about the challenges you have encountered.
Suggest a new deadline and offer to provide updates on your progress.
tasks.to: Dr. Jones Subject: Request for extension on research project deadline
tasks.subject: Request for extension on research project deadline
tasks.title: Write an Email
